full_prompt_en: A square garden photograph looks uphill along a narrow gray paved path that becomes a series of dark steps at the center. The path begins at the lower middle, squeezed between enormous mounds of feathery pale green grass on the left and darker, denser planting on the right. It climbs in a straight line through the middle distance, then disappears into a soft rise near the top. On both sides, the sloping beds are layered with rounded tufts of gold, olive, and fresh green grasses. Low purple flowering masses weave between them; some grow as broad cushions and others as thin upright stems. At right foreground, tall seed heads and deep burgundy-purple plants partly frame the path. At left, a broad cream-colored grass clump spills toward the walkway, its fine blades catching the light. The middle ground shows repeated bands of purple, green, and straw color stepping up with the land. A lone rounded tree stands just left of center near the upper slope, while a line of softer dark trees recedes behind it. The sky is pale gray and slightly misty, occupying only a slim strip above the plantings. The view is at walking height, centered on the steps, so the garden seems to draw the viewer forward between its textured banks. Gentle overcast light gives each cluster shape without harsh cast shadows. The photograph is rich in fine stems and seed heads yet composed in broad flowing color masses. The straight stair provides calm structure against the loose, interwoven planting.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形花园照片沿着狭窄灰色铺路向上望去，小路在中央变成一串深色台阶。路径从下方中部开始，左边硕大的羽毛状浅绿草丛与右边更深、更密的种植带把它夹住。它笔直爬过中景，在上方的柔和坡顶附近消失。两侧斜坡花床层叠着金色、橄榄色和鲜绿的圆簇草。低矮紫色花丛穿插其间，有些像宽厚靠垫，有些长成细直花茎。右前景，高种穗与深酒红紫色植物部分框住小路。左边，一大簇奶油色草向步道溢出，纤细草叶承接光线。中景随地势抬升，反复出现紫、绿和稻草色带。上方坡面近中央偏左立着一棵圆冠树，身后还有一排更柔、更暗的远树。天空浅灰、略有雾气，只占植被上方窄窄一条。视点在步行高度，居中面对台阶，使花园仿佛把观者引向纹理丰富的草岸之间。柔和阴天光让每一簇植物成形，没有硬投影。照片充满细茎和种穗，却以宽阔流动的色块组织。笔直台阶给松散交织的种植带提供平静结构。
style_prompt_en: Photography organizes abundant fine organic texture into legible flowing masses. Layer airy filaments, upright seedlike marks, and compact soft clusters so near and distant planes differ in density. Use sage, olive, straw gold, cream, mauve, violet, and burgundy in interleaving bands, with restrained saturation under a pale gray atmosphere. A narrow firm linear path or axis can draw the eye through loose asymmetrical banks. Gentle overcast light preserves subtle color differences and volume without hard-edged shadows. Keep foreground details crisp and let the distance soften slightly. The transferable effect is immersive but ordered, balancing intricate natural texture against one calm directional structure and muted seasonal color.
style_prompt_zh: 摄影把丰盛的细有机纹理组织成清楚可读的流动色块。层叠轻盈丝状线、竖立的种穗状记号和紧凑柔软的簇团，让近远平面有不同密度。鼠尾草绿、橄榄色、稻草金、奶油色、淡紫、紫罗兰与酒红以互相穿插的色带出现，在浅灰大气下维持克制饱和度。一道窄而坚定的线性通路或轴线引导视线穿过松散不对称的两侧。柔和阴天光保留细微色差与体积，而不产生硬边阴影。前景细节清楚，远处稍微柔化。可迁移的效果沉浸而有序，在精密自然肌理、一条平静方向结构和柔和季节色之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A narrow garden stair between drifts of grasses and purple flowers
theme_zh: 狭窄花园台阶穿过起伏草丛与紫花
name: Piet Oudolf
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
